takeaways: The post BYOK and enterprise custom models in the Copilot usage API appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
Requests go from Copilot CLI or the GitHub Copilot app directly to the developer’s provider key or local model.

Local BYOK Local BYOK covers a developer’s own provider key and local models served by tools such as Ollama, Foundry Local, LM Studio, and llama-server. used_local_byok : Whether a user made at least one local BYOK request in Copilot CLI or the Copilot app that day.
